# Broadcaster — Mobile Containment Proof

The Awtsmoos gives live media freedom without exile and action without visual noise;
Awtsmoos.com now keeps every broadcast control inside the glass while advanced power folds by choice.

## Proven behavior

- Existing Broadcaster contract suite remains 7/7 green.
- Drag controller already clamps media against the live responsive stage rectangle, so working drag behavior was preserved rather than rewritten.
- Primary `.action` controls now have fine-pointer hover, universal active press, focus-visible, disabled, and reduced-motion states.
- Advanced disclosure now has matching hover, active, focus-visible, and reduced-motion behavior.
- Advanced checkbox uses the product accent rather than an unrelated browser-default color.
- Advanced disclosure remains closed by default.

## Measured geometry

Desktop 1440×900 with Advanced opened:
- Horizontal overflow: 0.
- Stage: 980×560, fully contained.
- No visible interactive control crosses a viewport side edge.

Phone 390×844 with Advanced opened:
- Horizontal overflow: 0.
- Stage: 358×500 between x=16 and x=374.
- Primary actions: two 175×46 touch targets, fully contained.
- Advanced panel: 358px wide, fully contained.

Short phone 320×568 with Advanced opened:
- Horizontal overflow: 0.
- Stage: 288×386 between x=16 and x=304.
- Primary actions: two 140×58 touch targets, fully contained.
- Advanced panel right edge: 304 within 320 viewport.
- Final disclosure summary hitbox: 44px high, fixing the previously measured 18px native summary target.

## Architecture proof

- `styles/controls.css`: 105 lines.
- `styles/advanced-controls.css`: 71 lines.
- `git diff --check -- apps/broadcaster` passes.
- No long-line violations were found in the split files.

## Delta conclusion

The only production defects proven in this wave were incomplete active-state semantics on animated controls and an undersized Advanced summary hitbox. Both are resolved. No broader layout rewrite is justified; the existing responsive stage and drag system are already working.

## NEXT_ACTION

Inspect DB Console's current modified/untracked tree and diff completely. Reproduce any mobile form/result containment issue at 390×844 and 320×568 before changing production source.
